exchange_id.description: A recorded GET/HEAD/OPTIONS exchange, made by the data's owner.

include_anonymous.description: Also try with no credentials (default true).

outline.description:
Short outline: JSON shape or HTML title/forms. Kept even when the
text is cut, because it's the most useful part for a model.

text.description: Body text, wrapped in untrusted markers when it came from the target.

EngageFilter.description: Which recorded exchanges the tools look at.

in_scope.description: Only in-scope exchanges (default: true when the ROE has a scope).

max_scan.description: Most exchanges looked at, newest first (default 3000, max 20000).

possible_prompt_injection.description: Phrases in target content that look like attempts to instruct a model.

add_evidence.description: Exchange ids to add to the evidence.

severity.description: critical, high, medium, low or info

status.description: Humans: suspected, confirmed, false_positive, reported, fixed, accepted_risk. Agents: suspected.

HistoryFilter.description: Filters for searching history. All set fields must match.

actor.description: Who sent it, e.g. human:local or agent:claude.

after_id.description: Only exchanges with an id greater than this (newer ones; for paging forward).

annotated.description: With true: only exchanges that have a highlight or a comment (false is the same as leaving it out).

before_id.description:
Only exchanges with an id less than this (older ones). For paging back, pass `next_before_id` from the
previous result.

hide_ext.description:
File extensions to hide, comma-separated, e.g. "png,jpg,css,js". Matched against the path before any
query; a leading dot is allowed and case is ignored.

hypothesis_id.description: Exchanges sent while testing this hypothesis (its id).

identity.description: Exchanges sent with this identity's credentials (the exact identity name).

in_scope.description: With true: only targets in scope (the rules of engagement); applied by the service.

q.description:
A history query (`pm_tools::hql`), applied by the service: field:value terms (all must match), OR, -term,
parentheses; field~regex. Fields: host path url method status ext len reqlen time id source actor identity
comment highlight mime req resp any reqheader respheader param is. Numbers take >N <=N N..M, status 4xx.
E.g. status:>=500 -ext:js resp~"(?i)sql" respheader:set-cookie. Text terms read messages, so a page may stop
early (see `scanned` and `next_before_id` in the result).

source.description: Where the exchange came from: proxy (browser traffic) or replay (sent via ProxyMind).

status_class.description:
Only these status classes, as digits: "2,3" for 2xx and 3xx, "4,5" for errors, "0" for exchanges with no
response. Combine with `status` and `q` as usual (all must match).

text.description: Free text: the host, the path (with query) or the comment contains it (case-insensitive).

contains.description: Only operations whose key contains this text.

include_objects.description: Also list objects with their owners (default false; there can be many).

object_type.description: Only objects of this type, e.g. Order.

description.description: What is wrong, impact, and how to reproduce.

evidence.description: Exchange ids that show the issue.

hypothesis_id.description: Hypothesis this finding comes from (kept with the finding).

severity.description: critical, high, medium, low or info

url.description: Affected URL; defaults to the first evidence exchange's URL.

approval_id.description: From a previous pending_approval result: runs the approved proof. All other fields must be identical.

attacker.description: differential_authz: identity that should NOT have access.

baseline_raw.description: timing: normal request (defaults to the exchange's request).

exchange_id.description:
Recorded exchange to work from (the owner's request for
differential_authz; the baseline for timing; the target for oast).

finding_id.description: Mark this finding as proven if the proof succeeds.

hypothesis_id.description: Mark this hypothesis as confirmed if the proof succeeds.

identity.description: timing/oast/reflection: send with this identity's credentials.

marker_kind.description:
marker: what to prove — "redirect" (open redirect), "crlf" (CRLF header
injection), "host" (Host-header injection: the marker comes back in an
absolute URL) or "cors" (an `Origin` carrying the marker is trusted with
credentials). The request goes in `raw` with `{{marker}}` where a fresh
random value should be placed.

markers.description:
path_traversal: a marker expected in each file request's response (same
order as the file requests in `raws`, i.e. offset by the two leading
baseline/control requests), e.g. "root:". Values from the target are
untrusted; these are strings ProxyMind chose, so safe to match on.

min_effect_ms.description: timing: required median slowdown in ms (default 500).

oracle.description:
differential_authz, timing, oast, reflection, sql_error,
boolean_injection, path_traversal, expression or marker

owner.description:
differential_authz: identity that owns the data (defaults to the one
the exchange was made as).

payload_raw.description: timing: the same request with the delay payload.

raw.description:
oast: request containing {{oast}} where the callback URL goes, or
{{oast_dns}} where a host name to resolve goes (needs a DNS listener).
reflection: request containing {{xss}} (payload as is), {{xss_url}}
(percent-encoded) or {{token}} (inside a payload of your own).

raws.description:
sql_error: [baseline, quote, second quote, harmless change] raw
requests. boolean_injection: [baseline, true-condition,
false-condition]. path_traversal: [baseline, control, file-1, file-2, …] where
each file-N request reads a known file; `markers[N]` is what proves it.
expression: [baseline, control, payload-1, payload-2, …] where each
payload sends an arithmetic expression and `markers[N]` is its result;
the control sends the same numbers without template delimiters.

url.description: timing/oast: scheme://host[:port] when there is no exchange_id.

view_raw.description:
reflection: a request for the page that shows what `raw` stored
(stored XSS). `raw` is sent first, then this, and this page is the one
rendered.

wait_seconds.description: oast: how long to wait for a callback (default 10 s, max 60).

ReplayRequest.description:
A request to send. Either `exchange_id` (resend or edit a recorded
request) or `url` (where to send `raw`) must be given.

approval_id.description: Run a previously approved send. All other fields must be identical.

exchange_id.description: Recorded exchange to base this on (its target is used).

fix_content_length.description: Update Content-Length to match the body (default true).

hypothesis_id.description: Hypothesis this send tests (links the exchange as evidence).

identity.description:
Send with this test identity's credentials instead of the request's own
(names from identity_list; use "anonymous" for none).

max_tokens.description: Token budget of the returned view (default 1500; at least 200).

normalize_newlines.description: Convert bare "\n" line endings in the head to "\r\n" (default true).

raw.description:
Raw HTTP/1.1 request text. May contain `{{secret:...}}` placeholders.
If omitted, the request of `exchange_id` is resent unchanged.

url.description: Target as scheme://host[:port], used when there is no `exchange_id`.

view.description: View of the response to return (default summary).

oneOf.description: Sent; the response is recorded as `exchange_id`.
The send failed (e.g. connection refused); recorded as `exchange_id`.
A human must approve first; call again with `approval_id`.

approval_id.description: Approval for the crawl, if the gate asked for one.

browser.description:
Crawl in a headless browser that runs the app's JavaScript (default:
yes when a Chromium is installed).

checks.description: Checks to run (default all; submissions only get stored_xss and csrf).

crawl.description: Crawl first (default true); without it, only what history holds.

identity.description:
Crawl and scan as this test identity (names from identity_list). The task logs in again when the session
ends and stops if that keeps failing.

profile.description:
A scan profile (light, default, thorough, api-only or a saved one)
that fills in the settings left out here.

record_findings.description: Record strong issues as suspected findings (default true).

url.description: Where to start, e.g. https://app.example.com/ (its origin is audited).

oneOf.description: Request line, status, key headers, short body preview.
Everything, truncated to the token budget.

WsOut.description: One message to send: `text`, or `hex` for binary data.

approval_id.description: From a previous pending_approval result: runs the approved send. All other fields must be identical.

hypothesis_id.description: Hypothesis this session tests (links the exchange as evidence).

identity.description: Open the socket as this test identity.

max_chars.description: Characters of each message shown back (default 2000).

messages.description: Sent in order, each followed by `wait_ms` of listening (at most 50).

raw.description:
Edited upgrade request (HTTP/1.1). Default: the recorded one.
ProxyMind sets a fresh Sec-WebSocket-Key and turns compression off.

wait_ms.description:
How long to listen after each message (and after opening). Default
1000, at most 10000; a whole session ends after 60 s.

info.description: Generated from the Rust types by `cargo xtask contracts`; do not edit by hand. Every request needs the per-install token, and requests that change anything must carry the header `X-ProxyMind: 1`. Only the routes listed here are described so far.
info.summary: REST API of the local ProxyMind app (part of it; see docs/adr/0019-typed-api-contracts.md).
